name: An Undelivered Letter
summary: In Goldshire, an old letter waits in the Lion's Pride Inn, carrying a clue to Stalvan Mistmantle's past.

sections.title: A Midnight Flight
sections.body: Years ago, a storm drove a traveling courier to the Lion's Pride Inn for shelter. Near midnight, fear sent the messenger downstairs in his sleeping clothes and out into the pouring rain. He vanished and never returned. In an upstairs chest, he left his belongings and a letter from Stalvan Mistmantle addressed to an estate in Stormwind City's Canal District.

sections.title: Tracing the Scholar
sections.body: In the inn's upper rooms, the unopened letter remained untouched for years. Now investigators retrace Stalvan's steps through Elwynn Forest. Taking the parchment to Caretaker Folsom in the capital carries the mystery from the inn to the heart of Stormwind.

faq.q: Where is the undelivered letter found?
faq.answer: The letter rests in a storage chest on the second floor of Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn, at the foot of a bed in a guest room.

faq.q: Why was the letter never delivered?
faq.answer: During a rainstorm, the courier carrying the letter took shelter at the Lion's Pride Inn. Around midnight, he panicked, ran downstairs in his nightclothes, and vanished into the storm, leaving his chest and its contents behind.
Stalvan Mistmantle wrote the letter. He had spent several nights at the inn around the same time as the frightened courier.

faq.q: Where is the letter supposed to go?
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to the Canal District of Stormwind City. It can be brought to Caretaker Folsom near the Park.

angles.text: For Alliance investigators, the courier's forgotten route runs from Goldshire's pastoral heart to Stormwind City's upper-class quarters.
